verdict.rationale: Datadog documents an Agent Console to 'monitor and analyze AI agent usage, cost, and productivity across your organization.' That is first-party cost and usage monitoring, but the evidence never mentions token counts, per-request or per-model breakdowns, or time-period dashboards, and the Agent Observability docs shown cover tracing and evaluations, not cost. Missing for 10: token usage metrics, per-request cost attribution, per-model breakdown, time-period dashboard views, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see cost and token usage per request, model, and time period in dashboards

citations.quote: Monitor and analyze AI agent usage, cost, and productivity across your organization in Datadog Agent Console
